items.title: PoC Exploit Released for Critical Outlook 0-Click Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
items.description: A Proof-of-Concept (PoC) exploit code has been released for a critical remote code execution (RCE) vulnerability in Microsoft Outlook, identified as CVE-2024-21413. Dubbed “MonikerLink,” this flaw allows attackers to bypass Outlook’s security mechanisms, specifically the “Protected View,” to execute malicious code or steal credentials. items.title: Hackers Allegedly Claim Breach of Mercedes-Benz USA Legal and Customer Data
items.description: A threat actor known as “zestix” has claimed responsibility for a significant data breach affecting Mercedes-Benz USA (MBUSA), allegedly exfiltrating 18.3 GB of sensitive legal and customer information.
